sections.heading: Using Hungarian Adjectives
paragraphs: Hungarian adjectives do not change for gender or number when placed before a noun. Only the noun gets plural endings.
When adjectives appear after the verb 'van/vannak', they also remain in basic form.

sections.heading: Using -i to Form Adjectives
paragraphs: The suffix -i can turn place or origin words into adjectives that mean 'from' or 'related to' a place.
These adjectives also remain unchanged before nouns.

sections.heading: Simple Examples
paragraphs: A nagy könyv. – The big book.
A szép diák. – The beautiful student.
Van egy fiatal tanár. – There is a young teacher.
